extDescription.message: OpenNDM-Extension: send downloads and page media to Neat Download Manager. Ctrl-click to skip, block sites, Manifest V3.

mailAttachmentBrowser.message: Mail attachment links do not work with NDM; use the browser instead.

popupCaptureDesc.message: Supported links are handed to Neat Download Manager automatically.

popupSiteBlockDesc.message: All downloads here stay in the browser.

popupMediaPanelDesc.message: Applies to this page; a compact pill stays when minimised.

optionsSubtitle.message: Capture downloads and page media, then hand them to Neat Download Manager.

connectionDesc.message: NDM listens on a local WebSocket port. Keep the default unless you changed it in NDM.

connectionHint.message: Start Neat Download Manager, then test again. The default port is 10007.

captureDesc.message: Only download-looking responses are taken over. Pages, scripts, images, and player segments stay in the browser.

captureEnabledDesc.message: Hand supported downloads to NDM automatically.

captureMediaDesc.message: Add network media and HLS playlists to the page media panel; nothing is downloaded automatically.

showMediaPanelDesc.message: Show a floating panel with media found on the page.

autoCancelDesc.message: Cancel Chrome’s copy after NDM accepted the task.

minMediaSizeDesc.message: Smaller media responses are left to the browser.

ctrlHint.message: Hold Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) while clicking a link to keep that download in the browser.

typesDesc.message: These types match the reference NDM add-on, with safer rules for browser assets.

blockedDesc.message: All downloads on these sites, including their subdomains, stay in the browser.

invalidSite.message: Enter a valid domain, for example example.com.

aboutDesc.message: A GPL-3.0-or-later rewrite for Manifest V3. Comments are bilingual in the source code.

privacyText.message: No analytics and no remote servers. Cookies and request metadata are sent only to the local NDM app at 127.0.0.1.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults?

testFailed.message: NDM is not reachable. Start the app and try again.

sizeInvalid.message: Enter a size of 0 MB or more.
